newsitem.title: CHINA: China starts work on seven new berths in Yantai.
newsitem.headline: China starts work on seven new berths in Yantai.

text.p: China has started work on seven new 10,000 dry-weight-tonne deep water berths in Yantai port in the eastern province of Shandong, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The project would include two container berths and would be completed in seven years at a cost of 2.2 billion yuan, Xinhua said.

Construction of the facilities, part of the port's third phase, would be financed by the Asian Development Bank, the State Development Bank of China and funds raised by the Yantai Port Administration, the agency said.
Yantai would have 38 berths, including 19 deep water ones, on completion of the first part of the project, it said but gave no further details.
